QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says memory_buffer_alloc.c installs its allocator via mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free, which exists only under MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY. But it never says the buffer allocator itself requires MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY, or that enabling the buffer allocator alone is not enough.
